findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_item_details, get_new_limiteds, find_page · Private data: search_items, find_page, get_player_holdings · Public sink: get_started_guide, get_release_cohorts · Destructive: search_items.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_item_details, get_new_limiteds, find_page · Private data: search_items, find_page, get_player_holdings · Public sink: get_started_guide, get_release_cohorts · Destructive: search_items

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_item_details" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
